name: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial
source:
You wake up in a strange place, only to realize you have been abducted along with seven other people. A city guard, a royal soldier, a witch, a bard, a librarian and two criminals... What force could be powerful enough to bring you all against your will, and why?

Then a demonspawn appears, giving everyone a "friendly warning" that some demonhearts are among you - people blessed with regeneration, but cursed to be hunted by everyone else. Being a demonheart yourself, you don't want the others to find out.

Mysterious deaths start happening, and the survivors need to identify the murderer. As former friends betray one another, someone benefits. Who is the traitor?

While trying to survive the demonspawn's trial, you can romance two of the men trapped with you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你在一個陌生的地方醒來，隨後發現，自己和另外七個人一起遭到了綁架。一名城市衛兵、一名王家士兵、一名女巫、一名吟遊詩人、一名圖書管理員，還有兩名罪犯……究竟是什麼力量，能將你們所有人強行帶到這裡？又是為了什麼？

隨後，一名魔裔現身，給了眾人一個「友善的提醒」：你們之中混入了惡魔之心——他們擁有再生的恩賜，卻也背負著遭到所有其他人追殺的詛咒。而你自己就是惡魔之心，因此不願讓別人發現這個秘密。

神秘的死亡接連發生，倖存者必須找出兇手。昔日的朋友互相背叛，而有人從中獲利。究竟誰是叛徒？

在設法熬過魔裔的試煉、活下去的同時，你也可以與兩名同樣被困於此的男子發展戀情。

（摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/]Steam[/url]）
